verdict.rationale: Undermind offers a paper-publication alert feature that notifies users when new relevant papers appear, which is a narrow instance of an event-triggered action, but there is no evidence of a general rule-definition or automation framework (e.g., custom triggers/conditions tied to multiple action types). missing for 10: rule-builder UI or API for defining arbitrary trigger conditions, evidence of multiple action types beyond notifications, and any independent confirmation the alert feature works as described.
